globalThis.comparison=(()=>{
 const checks={},v=Number(globalThis.variant)||0,near=(a,b)=>Math.abs(a-b)<.1,font=globalThis.contractFontFamily||'monospace';
 const sheet=document.createElement('style');sheet.textContent='html,body{margin:0;padding:0}div{font:16px/20px '+font+';margin:0;padding:0;border:0}span{display:inline-block;margin:0;padding:0;border:0}';document.head.append(sheet);
 const make=(count,css='width:40px;height:20px',width=120)=>{const p=document.createElement('div');p.style.width=width+'px';for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const n=document.createElement('span');n.style.cssText=css;p.append(n);}document.body.append(p);return p;};
 let probe=make(1);const line=probe.getBoundingClientRect().height;checks.single=near(probe.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect().width,40)&&line>=20;probe.remove();
 let p=make(3);const a=p.children;checks.adjacent=near(a[1].getBoundingClientRect().x-a[0].getBoundingClientRect().x,40)&&near(a[2].getBoundingClientRect().x-a[0].getBoundingClientRect().x,80)&&near(p.getBoundingClientRect().height,line);p.remove();
 p=make(4+v%3);checks.wrap=near(p.getBoundingClientRect().height,line*2)&&near(p.children[3].getBoundingClientRect().x,p.getBoundingClientRect().x)&&near(p.children[3].getBoundingClientRect().y-p.children[0].getBoundingClientRect().y,line);p.remove();
 probe=make(1,'font:24px/30px '+font);probe.firstElementChild.textContent='A';const large=probe.getBoundingClientRect().height;probe.remove();p=make(2,'');p.firstElementChild.textContent='A';p.children[1].style.font='24px/30px '+font;p.children[1].textContent='A';checks.mixed=near(p.getBoundingClientRect().height,large);p.remove();
 p=make(1,'font:10px/12px '+font,15);p.style.font='10px/12px '+font;p.firstElementChild.textContent='A A A A';checks.multiline=near(p.firstElementChild.getBoundingClientRect().width,15)&&near(p.getBoundingClientRect().height,48);p.remove();
 p=make(3);p.children[1].style.transform='translateX(5px)';checks.translation=near(p.children[1].getBoundingClientRect().x-p.children[0].getBoundingClientRect().x,45)&&near(p.children[2].getBoundingClientRect().x-p.children[0].getBoundingClientRect().x,80)&&near(p.getBoundingClientRect().height,line);p.remove();
 p=make(3);p.style.width='80px';checks.mutation=near(p.getBoundingClientRect().height,line*2)&&near(p.children[2].getBoundingClientRect().x,p.getBoundingClientRect().x);p.remove();p=make(2,'width:40px;height:20px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden');p.children[0].textContent='A'.repeat(40);p.children[1].textContent='A'.repeat(40);p.children[1].style.textOverflow='ellipsis';checks.ellipsisGeometry=near(p.children[0].getBoundingClientRect().width,p.children[1].getBoundingClientRect().width)&&near(p.children[0].getBoundingClientRect().height,p.children[1].getBoundingClientRect().height)&&p.children[0].scrollWidth===p.children[1].scrollWidth&&p.children[1].scrollWidth>40;p.remove();sheet.remove();return checks;
})();
